reviews.author: Anitha Ravichandran
reviews.text:
Review for Dr. Aishwarya

I am writing this review on behalf of my sister. What a tough journey she had gone through becoming a mother. After facing the heartbreak of two failed IVF attempts, our cute little princess🫅 has arrived. Words cannot fully express the gratitude my family and I feel for Dr. Aishwarya. After the two IVF failures, we were losing hope—but then Dr. Aishwarya changed everything.

Throughout the pregnancy, Dr. Aishwarya was not just a doctor—she was a constant pillar of strength. From the very first consultation, she showed incredible compassion, patience, and deep expertise and her calm demeanor, regular follow-ups, and thorough guidance made all the difference. Every concern was addressed with clarity and kindness and she recommends only the best to her patients. Every milestone we achieved was celebrated like a shared victory.

Thanks to her unwavering commitment and expertise, today my sister finally held her healthy, beautiful miracle baby girl in her arms—a moment we feared might never come. We will forever be thankful to Dr. Aishwarya for helping us bring this little blessing into our lives. If you're looking for a gynecologist who truly cares, supports, and delivers miracles—look no further. Dr. Aishwarya is a real angel on earth.

# Special mention to Dr. Ashwin and Staffs of Accumed Speciality Clinic and Scans

reviews.author: Rasiyawan Yadav
reviews.text:
A HEARTFELT THANK YOU TO DR. AISHWARYA, DR. ASHWIN & THE ACCUMED TEAM

We’re incredibly thankful to Dr. Aishwarya, Dr. Ashwin, and the entire team at Accumed Speciality Clinic & Scan for their amazing support throughout our journey to parenthood.
After moving to Chennai for first time and meeting Dr. Aishwarya was truly a turning point for us. Dr. Aishwarya’s expertise and deep understanding guided us through every challenge, and her encouragement gave us strength when we needed it the most. We can never forget the positive vibes we got after 1st visit and meeting with mam. Dr. Ashwin was incredibly kind and professional during every scan. He took the time to clearly explain the purpose of each scan and kept us informed about our progress at every stage, which really helped to keep us calm and reassured.

A heartfelt thank you to the amazing support staff at Accumed—Sis Anuradha, Sis Sarmila, Sis Ashwini, and Sis Madhumitha. Your kindness, patience, and unwavering support made our journey so much easier. We deeply appreciate all that you did to ensure we felt cared for and comfortable during every visit to the clinic.

Accumed truly felt like a second home—warm, supportive, and constantly reassuring. We’ll always be deeply grateful to Dr. Aishwarya ma’am, Dr. Ashwin sir, and the entire Accumed Specialty Clinic team for their exceptional care and support.

We highly recommend Dr. Aishwarya ma’am and the Accumed Clinic as a one-stop solution for all fertility/gynecology-related concerns. Their expertise, compassion, and comprehensive care truly make a difference.

reviews.text:

Our entire pregnancy journey was seamless, thanks to the combined efforts of Dr. Aishwarya (OBG) and Dr. Ashwin Muralidharan (Radiologist). We also deeply appreciate the ASCAS team—Anu, Sharmila, Uma, Madhu, and Ashwini—for their warm hospitality and unwavering support.
